posts.author: Prabhat_Mohanty
posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: As we know, the company is sitting on a cash pile. On sum of the total business it is cheap. The stock was bitten down due to non distribution of Duestar proceeds. It is still under the Hangover due to action by promoter, who is slowly Ring fencing by cryptic aquisition of shares. Meanwhile financial closure of the copper projects hang in balance. So at present not much to write about except H acid and pigment price increase. Copper ore mine ownership, if it happens will be a positive but it is a long time frame.

posts.author: Ugesh
posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: Australian miner Celsius remains challenging Kiri aggressively. Based on the Events of Default notices issued by Equinaire, foreclosure looks weak and likely to be reversed at arbitration. Due to this, market is not clearly pricing in any of the positive developments linked to the 40% MMCI stake acquisition. Unless any substantive development at the project site or favorable outcome from arbitration, Kiri will have hard time to get re-rated. Celcius next steps 1362×1034 102 KB

posts.text: This thread highlights the importance of activists like Icahn, Ackman and Paul Singer. While I haven’t found anything in their financial statement that constitutes a “fraud”, I think their disclosures to minority shareholders should be lot better. Major concerns for me: 1) the proposed 500 cr loan arrangement to a company Kiri Industries owns only 48% of: Kiri Infrastructure. They’re basically giving a company with 27 cr net worth + 0 revenue An unsecured loan of 500 cr, AT 7%. Just 7. This to me is not fair. posts.author: Sanket_Patole
posts.community: Kiri Industries: Loan reduction and demand surge
posts.text: Financial Closure has not been achieved yet. The promoters have had a habit of over promising and missing deadlines (but not sharing the true timelines with the minority shareholders). Keeping in mind that eventually and each time they’ve managed to achieve their goals & targets, is this still a big Red Flag, as inability to secure the debt funding can really mess up the things this time?
